gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Referral field hiding logic standardized The hiding logic triggered by the 'no referral' checkbox will be applied to both the secondary referral and referral notes fields. (Decisions > Aligned); also Details: "Kobi Kunasekaran agreed that this should be corrected for both the primary and secondary referral fields"
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: even for the referral notes and secondary referral, we should probably do the same logic. But let let me check and confirm all my notes. Uh because the no referral was supposed to be mainly for the primary referral, which is the the first lookup. Um, I don't know if they could have like a secondary referral without a primary referral. So, I'll need to check that with them and confirm.
gemini_disagreements.why: Summary lists this as an aligned decision. In the transcript Kobi first says 'no, this is okay', then says he must check with the client before confirming. Details also names the wrong fields ('primary and secondary referral'); the fields discussed are secondary referral and referral notes.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: The team decided to correct referral field visibility and designate payout amounts as read-only for representatives to ensure consistent system usability.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: So I think it actually I think it is read only but because I'm logged in as an admin uh I believe it's showing up as editable ... Kobi Kunasekaran: Um, and it is for reps, but for non-reps it, uh, they are editable. / Cedrick Infantado: Sure. I just check that one.
gemini_disagreements.why: No change was decided. Kobi believes payout amount is already read-only for reps, and Cedrick will check. The summary presents it as a new design decision.
